correctness.rationale: Read full n-factor derivation: represent each allowed nonzero μ=r e^{it}, |t|<π/2, r≤cos t, and boundary c=0 (prior Cor.3.1 is explicitly a premise). Jensen strict concavity log cos yields product radius ≤cos^n((sum t)/n)≤B_n(θ). Equality forces equal shortest-winding phases, all radii on generator boundary, hence zero total intercept. For strict slope inequality n identical interior slopes μ=ρ^{1/n}exp(iθ/n) and one outer intercept construct every b. Monotonicity of x log cos(θ/x) and its Taylor series prove exact minimal n/m+1 and fixed-nonzero-angle asymptotic. Excluded nonzero constant and nonidentity unitary maps follow from nonzero slopes and the disk. Independent checks of 2400 product bounds and 700 exact affine constructions agree. Caveat: full text of prerequisite recognition Cor.3.1 not retrievable under authorized access; assessed proof valid conditional on its quoted published theorem; do not equate diagnostic sampling with all-parameter proof.
